big_case.notes: Final-judgment Second Amendment challenge to nine sweeping categories of public-carry bans in Maryland (parks, mass transit, hospitals, schools, museums, entertainment venues, bars/restaurants, government buildings, demonstrations), litigated by prominent national gun-rights counsel against a state Governor and AG. It produced a divided Fourth Circuit opinion, a relist, and a detached Statement of Justice Thomas respecting the denial of certiorari, placing it well above routine cert petitions, though certiorari was denied so it establishes no binding national merits precedent.
